args.Description: Two surgical fixes: (1) Magnifier now renders only raw line/circle geometry inline — no map pin, no background, no anchor SVG — with a crisp amber dot + crosshair at the cursor center. (2) Vertex hit-test now fires for BOTH p1 and p2 on any line regardless of anchor state; the anchor-handle guard is restricted to ADD_LINE tool only so finished segment start-nodes are draggable.
args.Instruction: Fix 1: Replace the magnifier's <use href="#cad-drawing-layer"> with explicit inline rendering of only cadLines and cadCircles (no map pin, no background image, no polygons). Add a crisp dot + crosshair at center instead. Fix 2: Widen vertex drag hit-test in handleCadPointerDown to check BOTH p1 and p2 for all lines when in IDLE/non-editing mode, and ensure the anchor-handle check does NOT fire when cadTool is not ADD_LINE, so that tapping p1 of a finished segment correctly triggers vertex drag.

args.Description: Unfreeze pointer events during metric input by enabling two-way vertex hit-testing in ADD_LINE mode. Tapping either vertex instantly retargets the Map Pin (cadAnchorNode) and triggers isDraggingAnchor to bind real-time distance rendering for both start and end nodes.
args.Instruction: Update TWO-WAY VERTEX HIT-TEST block to handle `cadTool === 'ADD_LINE'` dynamically by re-targeting `cadAnchorNode` and initiating `isDraggingAnchor`, exactly matching the anchor-handle drag logic, rather than setting `cadDraggingNode` which is inactive for metric prompt state.
args.toolAction: Updating vertex hit-test for ADD_LINE mode

args.Description: Fix polygon closure bug by restricting the Two-Way Vertex Hit-Test to only intercept node clicks during the Metric Input phase (cadPrompt active), allowing active drawing clicks (no prompt) to pass through to the line generation logic in handleCadPointerUp.

This ensures that when the user is actively drawing (no prompt), clicking a cross node doesn't get intercepted as a drag attempt, allowing the line to form.
